pages.text: Deadlier than the King, and dressed better.

pages.title: Finding Her
pages.text: The Queen keeps her own altar, her own royal tree, and her own Challenge Tower — each with a Waystone shrine planted at the door by considerate cartographers.$(p)Her scales are the heart of the pack's finest protection: Queen armor and the Queen Battle Axe are both forged from Queen Scales won in battle.
Nine buried Queen Parts summon her anywhere. Choose 'anywhere' with enormous care.

pages.title: What They Leave Behind
pages.text: Her scales mint half the Court's economy: eight around an egg incubate a $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/royal_dragon_egg)Prince of your own$(), they press into $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/upgrade_orbs)upgrade orbs$(), and the Bumblezone's Bee Queen $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/court_economy)pays royal jelly for them$(), monarch to monarch. Her $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/spell_scrolls)Holy scrolls$() share the King's jackpot odds.$(p)Deadlier, better dressed — and better banked.
